subject: Culture
title: Ramadan's Purpose
description: A quick, practical guide to Ramadan's Purpose.

hook.text: During Ramadan, 1.8 billion Muslims go without food or water from sunrise to sunset for a month.

buildup.text: The Quran was first revealed during Ramadan. Fasting honors that event and builds spiritual discipline.

discovery.text: Ramadan shifts 11 days earlier each year because it follows the lunar calendar. Summer fasts can last 18 hours.

twist.text: Food consumption actually rises during Ramadan. Iftar feasts after sunset can be enormous.

climax.text: The fast isn't about hunger. It's about empathy, self-control, and remembering that plenty isn't permanent.

punchline.text: The emptiness is the point, not the punishment.

quiz.question: Why does Ramadan shift dates each year?
